name: Išpakāya
contribution: A Scythian king who ruled during the period of the Scythian presence in Western Asia in the 7th century BCE.
legacy: Graeco-Roman authors confused this person with his predecessors and successors, including his possible grandson Madyes, into a single figure by claiming that it was Madyes himself who led the Scythians from Central Asia into chasing the Cimmerians out of their homeland and then defeating the Medes and the legendary Egyptian king Sesostris and imposing their rule over Asia for many years before returning to Scythia

checks.lead: Išpakāya was a Scythian king who ruled during the period of the Scythian presence in Western Asia in the 7th century BCE.
